subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cheerful
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cheerful"** means noticeably happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्न)

 
 
• **Example:** She always has a** cheerful** smile on her face, no matter the situation.
 
 
 
• **"Gloomy"** refers to a state of being dark, depressing, or pessimistic. (उदास)
 
 
• **Example:** The room felt** gloomy **after the lights went out and the rain started pouring.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Cheerful'** is **'Gloomy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Joyful** (आनंदित): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** The** joyful** children ran around the playground with big smiles on their faces.
 
 
 
• **Sunny** (धूपदार): Bright with sunlight; cheerful and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a **sunny** disposition that brightens up everyone's day.
 
 
 
• **Hilarious** (प्रफुल्लित करने वाला): Extremely amusing or funny.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's** hilarious** jokes had everyone in stitches.
